section: 20. Epilogue: The Return of Spring to Gensokyo
description: Spring Energy returned to Gensokyo, the snow melted, sunflowers bloomed again, cherry trees sprouted new buds, everyone returned to their places, and spring finally returned to Gensokyo.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Long'er walked for a while before arriving at the entrance of the Bamboo Forest. At the entrance, a familiar white-haired figure was leaning against a bamboo. "Why are you back only now?" "Is the matter resolved?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Yes, the Spring Energy has been returned."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "I see." The girl approached and helped pat the dust off Long'er. "Let's go, Kaguya and Keine have been waiting for you for a long time." "Can't you be faster?" The girl sighed.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Sorry, the opponent was quite strong too." #Long'er touched his pocket and pulled out a card.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Well, just be careful next time."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "This is for you."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Mokou sighed, didn't say anything to Long'er, just walked behind him towards home. "What is this?" "Grass." "You used this?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #The card was engraved with a knight clad in black armor.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "I can feel a little bit... the sensation of my Spell Card inside." "You didn't crash to death?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I probably shouldn't die from just one hit." "But your ability is too reckless."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "It's a miracle you didn't crash to death." Mokou sighed. "Don't be so reckless next time." "Take good care of yourself." "We're almost home." In the distance of the Bamboo Forest, the shadow of a wooden house was faintly visible.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er put the card into Mokou's pants pocket. "Use it next time you want to use my power."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Mm." Mokou smiled. "We're here." You stand in front of a wooden house.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Why does it feel like a long time has passed even though only a day has gone by?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Really?" "One day or ten days are essentially the same." "Can't tell the difference in length." Mokou pondered.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It's good to be alive."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Mm." "Being alive is enough." Mokou pointed at the small wooden house, which emitted a warm, cozy light. "So, shall we have hot pot?" "We've been waiting for you for a really, really long time."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I'm already starving."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Let's go."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Follow Mokou as she opens the door and enters the house.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Inside the wooden house, a long-haired woman in pink casual wear was quietly sipping tea with her eyes closed, and next to her was a silver-haired, intellectual woman in a blue long skirt. The two sighed upon seeing your arrival, then smiled. "We've been waiting for you for a long time." Such a scene did not exist. Inside the wooden house, it was currently a mess. Although the hot pot on the table was spared, the room looked like it had been ransacked by bandits. "Ahhhhh, yamero, Mokou you bastard, it's a full moon today ahhhhh, why did you bring her here?" In the small house, Kaguya was complaining while running away, chased by the green-haired Keine. "If I get caught by this kind of person I'm really done for, what are you still looking at, come save me!" Kaguya was still running. Keine was in an out-of-control state; Long'er seemed to only now realize that the Hakutaku is so crazy during a full moon, headbutting anyone she sees.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Will Teacher Kamishirasawa Keine remain in this state all night?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "..." Mokou twitched the corner of her mouth. "As long as she doesn't see the full moon." "Let's seal the windows later." Mokou sighed, inexplicably feeling mentally exhausted.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It's正好 for Princess Kaguya to get more exercise."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "I refuse, kora!" "I came here... huff... to eat hot pot." "I never heard about being chased by something like this ahhh!" Kaguya complained while lunging towards your direction. "Let's die together!" Behind her, the headbutt of the horned, green-haired Keine magnified before your eyes.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Together with Mokou, kick Kaguya back.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: It's already... too late.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Don't come over here!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: At the very moment the flying kick hit Kaguya, the grinning Keine had already headbutted. First, intense pain. Then, a feeling of weightlessness. "..." "..." When Long'er regained his senses, beside him was Mokou with a big bump on her head, and Kaguya with blood flowing from her head. You were still flying through the air. "I have lifted off, feeling fine." "..." "Why did it turn out like this?" Mokou sighed. The figures of the three flew through the night sky. "If this continues, perhaps I can return to the Lunar Capital."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I just thought I had finally not escaped death today."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hehe, now you're still getting beaten." Kaguya mocked. "Well, being a bit reckless is fine too, while you still can be reckless." Kaguya narrowed her eyes. The figures of the three soared straight to the bright moon in the night sky. Though it was reckless, Long'er's story was not without everyone's company. Perhaps being a bit reckless is fine. Yukari nodded, closing the gap. "Was it interesting?" She looked at Yuyuko beside her. "Hmm..." "It feels quite interesting with many people." Yuyuko nodded. "Then let's have a banquet. How about bringing Youmu along?" Yukari narrowed her eyes and opened her parasol. "Okay." "When?" "Hmm..." "Tomorrow." "At Hakurei Shrine." "Hold the grandest banquet." As Yukari spoke, she opened a gap. "Alright." Yuyuko pouted, agreeing. "Then... good night?" "Yes, good night." As Yukari's figure left Hakugyokurou, Yuyuko was alone again here. Youmu was already asleep in bed. Tonight, the girl still sat on the tree. "The maiden of Fuji, when the Saigyou Ayakashi is in full bloom, that is when the boundary between the living and the dead is separated. For her soul, resting in Hakugyokurou, seal the flower of the Saigyou Ayakashi as a barrier. If possible, may she never suffer again, forever forgetting the cycle of reincarnation..." She whispered, leaning against the Saigyou Ayakashi. "Well, what exactly was sealed, I don't care anymore." "Let's look forward to tomorrow~" The girl stretched, swinging her legs, just like when you first arrived, leaning against the Saigyou Ayakashi, waiting for time to pass. Tonight, when the last trace of the netherworld's chill dissipated in the morning light, Gensokyo welcomed its true awakening.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Life, life, life, life, darkness births beginnings; death, death, death, death, the underworld ends in death." #Long'er in Mokou's arms softly recited the poem.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The frozen Misty Lake, half a month old, emitted crisp cracking sounds as the ice layer shattered into countless sparkling fragments glittering in the sunlight. The waterfall of Youkai Mountain flowed again, and where the spray splashed, a seven-colored rainbow bridge formed. Eaves in the Human Village dripped with melting snow; children stepped barefoot into the warm, moist soil, chasing the first spring insects emerging from the frozen ground. Treetops in the Magic Forest tinged with new green; branches bent by snow trembled lightly, flicking off strings of diamond-like water droplets. Though the cherry trees at Hakurei Shrine were not yet in bloom, jade-green leaf buds had already formed on the withered branches; icicles on the edge of the Offering Box dripped with a tinkling sound, spreading dark water stains on the stone steps. In the Sunflower Field, golden flower heads uniformly turned eastward; frost and snow on the petals evaporated into hazy mist. Along both sides of the sandō to Moriya Shrine, early-blooming hydrangeas had already unfurled their leaves adorned with dewdrops. Even the bamboo leaves at Eientei rustled, shaking off their silvery winter coat. Frost flowers on the window lattices of the Scarlet Devil Mansion quietly melted, tracing winding water trails on the crimson glass. At the boundary between the netherworld and the present world, the last few retrograde cherry blossom petals finally dissipated into points of light. Replacing them was a warm wind rising from deep within the soil, carrying the fragrance of green grass. This morning, every resident who opened their window took a deep breath. It was the unique scent of Gensokyo's spring, mixed with damp earth, sprouting buds, and the smell of sunlight. This morning was exceptionally quiet. But Hakurei Shrine had a completely different atmosphere. It was very lively. The noisy red-white shrine maiden hugged the magician and Ge Qing beside her, wanting to drink heartily. By the way, the magician was still wearing the Scarlet Devil Mansion's maid outfit. Ever since being caught during the Scarlet Mist Incident, this girl hadn't managed to escape. Every time she tried to fly away, a bad woman with silver hair would catch her and bring her back. At one side of the table, Remilia was bored, picking at her nails. Flandre was pestering Koakuma, running around. Patchouli was still reading her book. Sakuya stayed by Remilia's side. Opposite her, Yuuka held Lina in her lap, while her right hand held Xueyu, bringing the whole family along. Youmu was busy in the kitchen. Yuyuko? She was at another dining table. If she joined this table, the food on this table wouldn't be safe either. Better to set up a separate table. The latecomers were Long'er. Long'er still had leaves and twigs on him, covered in dust all over. One might think he had slept outside. Following behind him was Mokou, not in much better condition. Well, though everyone was in a sorry state, though it was noisy and chaotic, this is Gensokyo, right? The story of the Spring Snow Incident has drawn to a close. But the story of Gensokyo is not over yet. Just like new buds still sprouting beneath the first snow, all of this is just the tip of the iceberg of Gensokyo's stories. Your journey has not ended yet. And it will never end. But this story has come to an end. Spring Snow Incident. THE END
